title: import-markus re-run is not a no-op: media metadata JSON key order
description: import-markus re-run reported updated 12 / unchanged 9 because _media_differs compares MediaAsset metadata JSON key order (AppSync reorders keys). Fix: semantic compare; audit Item comparison path.

comments.author: home
comments.text: PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Papyrus/pull/136 (branch feature/PPY-16a680-import-idempotent). Root cause: `_media_differs` compared MediaAsset `metadata` JSON strings byte-for-byte; AppSync reorders keys. Fix: parse JSON-encoded values before comparing. Item path compares `contentHash` strings, unaffected. New behave scenario fails without fix; full backend behave and CI (python, ts, smoke) pass. Not merged.

right_now_summary: A fix for metadata key-order comparisons passes tests, but PR #136 still awaits merge.
